summary: Frontend-only visual/contrast verification (Iter 297) for dark-mode fix on 'Contactos Globales del Principal (solo lectura)' inside the branch client edit dialog. Logged in as admin, toggled dark mode via [data-testid=theme-toggle-button], located a real branch (cli_dc77d71c6d98, parent INVERSIONES COLD 2024, 2 heredados: YISEL COLMENARES + MAURICIO DE SOUSA), opened the edit dialog, and inspected computed styles + screenshots. Fix confirmed: bg-white/70 rows are overridden to rgba(51,65,85,0.55) in .dark; text (slate-600/700) computed to rgb(159,171,188) / rgb(193,203,215) yielding legible contrast on the dark slate row. Light mode also verified: rows keep white 70% bg with dark slate text (no regression). Rest of the form in dark mode (labels, inputs, chips 'Perfilamiento de Procesos', local Contactos section, etc.) also displays with adequate contrast in the captured screenshot.

issues: No issue for the reported bug. Note: React hydration warnings observed in console: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>'. Not part of the current task but worth fixing at some point.

critical_code_review_comments: index.css .dark [class*='bg-white/60..95'] wildcard is broad; watch for false positives (e.g., any component using bg-white/60 as intentional bright overlay). For this app it's fine.
Clients.jsx is 2298 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (EditDialog, ContactsSection, InheritedContactsPanel) to reduce file size (>700 line guideline).
Console shows repeated React hydration errors (<tr> child of <span>, <span> child of <tbody>) originating from the Clients table markup — indicates an invalid nesting that should be cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branch used for repro: client_id=cli_dc77d71c6d98 (parent INVERSIONES COLD 2024). Open via [data-testid=client-actions-cli_dc77d71c6d98] → menuitem 'Editar' → panel [data-testid=inherited-contacts-panel]. Toggle theme with [data-testid=theme-toggle-button] (label 'Modo oscuro'/'Modo claro'). Dark-mode override lives in /app/frontend/src/index.css lines 149-153.
rca of the issue: Original bug: bg-white/70 rows were not covered by any .dark override so translucent white stayed visible over the parent dark panel; text-slate-600/700 was darkened by .dark rules → light text on light-ish translucent bg (very low contrast). Fix: added .dark [class*='bg-white/60..95'] { background-color: rgba(51,65,85,0.55) !important; } in index.css, mapping any high-opacity translucent white to a dark slate surface. Verified in-browser computed styles + screenshot.
